milestones.name: The Field
milestones.goal: Combat mechanics answer to every other system, and every unit and tile they introduce reads at 32×32.

tasks.description: Class list and multiclass prerequisites (Q6, Field half)
Tier-1 promotion forms: 12 forms, one ability and one silhouette each (Q38)
Enemy family list, profiles and grafted variant decks per chapter (Q29)
Named unit type pools per family, minimum set (Q39)
Speed formula shape: which of class, graft, scar, age, ink and armour modify it (Q27 rule)
Deployment zone and reinforcement wave rules per objective (Q33 rule)
Legibility: ink lines, scars and heraldry at 32×32 across four facings (Q51)
Sprites for the 12 tier-1 promotion forms
Sprites for new enemy families and named units
Tile list with per-stage variants (Q49)
Tile art for the tile list

milestones.name: The Road
milestones.goal: The map, its seasons and ships, and the events on it carry what every other system does to a journey.

tasks.description: Twelve starting capitals: terrain bands, harbours and landmarks (Q42)
Season model: which roads close when, and how seasons map to days and chapters (Q43)
Ship rules: days saved, exposure per crossing, the tide-caller's attention (Q44)
Day-cost rules: what costs days and what falls due (Q46 rule)
Ambition milestone tables per chapter (Q45)
Event placement: road versus node (Q47)
Event deck to a healthy size, carrying fixation, grudge and emeritus hooks (Q47, Q9)
tasks.notes: Exempt from the minimum-content rule: events carry most of the narrative-into-mechanics load.

tasks.description: Ward event (Q1, event half)
Map, node and edge art
